text: To purify it, add a small quantity of dilute sulphuric acid,
translation: To purify it, add a small quantity of dilute sulphuric acid,

text: and after evaporating to three quarters of its bulk, add a saturated solution of carbonate of potash or soda.
translation: and after evaporating to three quarters of its bulk, add a saturated solution of carbonate of potash or soda.
